ios.desc:
RecipeInbox is your digital cookbook for your social media recipes.

Scrolling through Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube and spotting a recipe you absolutely want to try? Instead of letting it vanish in your likes or saves, just share it to RecipeInbox – the app turns it into a recipe card and you can add your own flair.

FEATURES
- Save recipes from Reels, Shorts, and any website via the iOS share sheet
- Structured recipe cards with description, notes and ingredients
- You can also add your own recipes manually
- Organize with collections for weekly meal plans, favorite cuisines, or seasonal cooking
- Generate a shopping list directly from your recipe's ingredients
- Optional: Apple Intelligence structures shared recipe text on-device – disable any time in Settings
- Easy iCloud sync and backup across your Apple devices via SwiftData & CloudKit

PRIVACY FIRST
No account, no login, no ad tracking. Your recipes stay in your iCloud. 

BUY ONCE, KEEP FOREVER
The first 3 recipes are free. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited saves – no subscription, no hidden fees.
